provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft with host review/repairs, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.explanation: The emitted program finds the 4-connected components of the background colour, which is palette[0]. It skips any component that touches the grid border. Each remaining enclosed hole is filled with palette[2] when it exactly fills its bounding box and that box is square. This follows the archived solver and the generator: a red interior appears only for square boxes, including mini-square boxes inside square frames, while non-square boxes and junk-notched boxes stay black. Each D4 transform maps squares to squares and keeps rectangles solid. It also keeps border contact and 4-connectivity. So the same mechanism applies directly in visible coordinates for every d4, and only the colour constants are specialized by palette.
draft_notes.limitations: The background is taken as palette[0] rather than inferred as the most common colour. In generator scenes these agree, because 0 dominates. Wall colour (palette[5]) is not checked: any non-background cell counts as a wall. The fixtures are consistent with the uniform rule, and no contradictions were found. No tests were run.
